newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler sets $595 rebate on most minivans.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler sets $595 rebate on most minivans.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Tuesday it is offering a new $595 cash incentive on its minivan models equipped with the popular left-side sliding door.

The consumer incentive program runs through July. It replaces an "owner loyalty" incentive program that offered rebates fo $500 to $750 only to owners of Chrysler's 1984-96 model minivans, which expired on Monday.

The new program offers $595 cash allowances to buyers of 1996 and 1997 Dodge Caravan and Grand Caravan, Plymouth Voyager and Grand Voyager, and Chrysler Town & Country minivan models equipped with driver-side sliding doors. The payment completely offsets the price of the left-side door on vehicles that offer it as an option and also is available on vehicle that offer the door as standard equipment.
About 90 percent of Chrysler minivans sold today are ordered with the fourth door, which was first introduced on redesigned 1996 models.
Chrysler's combined U.S. minivan sales totaled an all-time high of 538,807 vehicles in 1996, and sales this year are near the record pace of a year ago.
In March 1997, minivan sales were 46,955, compared with 46,881 a year earlier.

"We're determined to maintain our position as the automotive industry's minivan leader by continuing to offer the best vehicles and the best values," said James Holden, Chrylser's executive vice president of sales and marketing. "This program helps us do that."
